tools.name: is_business_day_free
tools.description: FREE: check whether a date between today and 90 days ahead (JST) is a business day in Japan. Official Cabinet Office holiday data, supports bank calendar (Dec 31 - Jan 3). For other dates, business-day arithmetic or holiday lists use the paid tools.

tools.name: is_business_day
tools.description: Check whether a date is a business day in Japan (official Cabinet Office holiday data). Returns holiday name (JA/EN) and next/previous business day. Price: $0.005 USDC via x402.

tools.name: add_business_days
tools.description: Add or subtract N Japanese business days from a date (settlement T+N, delivery ETA). Price: $0.01 USDC via x402.

tools.name: list_holidays
tools.description: List Japanese national holidays for a year with JA/EN names. Price: $0.01 USDC via x402.

tools.name: payment_due_date
tools.description: Japanese payment terms (shimebi/shiharaibi) calculator, e.g. month-end close paid end of next month; shifts to the previous/next business day on weekends/holidays. Price: $0.01 USDC via x402.
